governance_quality_rationale: 87.2% overall certified (2,181/2,500). Structural consistency is strong across Packs A, B, C, E (all core fields at 500). Pack D has 1 known structural anomaly (FD-045). State coverage is complete (0 items missing question_state). Certified pool carries known residual defects (DL-008, DL-021, DL-026) that degrade learner experience quality but do not affect scoring correctness. Packs C and D lag at 70% certification — a 30-point gap from Packs B/E at 100%. Governance framework (5 rules, 20/20 tests) is active and enforced.
verdict_rationale: Three inconsistencies found: (1) Certification coverage ranges from 70% (C/D) to 100% (B/E) — a 30-point spread. (2) Pack D has 1 item (FD-045) with missing core content fields while all other packs are structurally complete. (3) Pack E Section C items are state-Certified but have a known DL-021 quality defect spanning 95 of 100 items — governance state and structural quality are decoupled. These inconsistencies do not block operations but should be addressed before declaring program-level governance closure.
